convention_rule: Four similar objects in a left-to-right row; the single green-lit object at position k (1-4) signals candidate Pk.
basis: Examples fit: r05 4th planter/birdhouse green=P4; r06 2nd post (A) green=P2; r07 1st barn/bale green=P1. In r08 both A and B show four street lamps with the 3rd from left glowing green, so P3 (client-correct is P4).
